لعبة تحقيق تفاعلية بأسلوب ملفات الجرائم:
An interactive detective game presented as classic crime files. Open a case, examine documents and evidence, hear the witnesses, and connect the clues on the board. Identify the culprit, then make your accusation.

Roles: players explore, investigate and accuse. Admins add, edit and remove case content. Super admins manage passwords, backups and resets.
